The row shows the user's email (often truncated, e.g. 'abdul+test@habitnu.c...') inside a react-bootstrap OverlayTrigger; the tooltip `
{email}
` is only added to the DOM on hover. react-bootstrap binds the tooltip to the email TEXT element's `mouseenter`, which does NOT bubble — so hovering the wrapping `.room-sub` container never triggers it. We therefore hover each element whose text contains the email local-part (this also matches the truncated label) until the tooltip becomes visible. Once a conversation is open the email can appear in several places, so we try each match in turn. """ local = email.split("@")[0] self.page.wait_for_timeout(2000) # let the conversation list fully render before hovering tooltip = self.page.locator(self.EMAIL_TOOLTIP.format(email=email)) text_targets = self.page.locator( f"xpath=//*[contains(normalize-space(text()),'{local}')]" ) for i in range(text_targets.count()): target = text_targets.nth(i) try: target.scroll_into_view_if_needed(timeout=2000) except Exception: continue self.page.mouse.move(0, 0) # reset hover state between attempts # Try a real cursor hover first (works in headed mode and triggers CSS :hover). # force=True bypasses Playwright's actionability checks so layout shifts or # overlapping elements (e.g. the unread badge in the row) don't block it. try: target.hover(timeout=2000, force=True) except Exception: pass # Also fire mouseenter/mouseover PROGRAMMATICALLY.
